description: Living 5W + How brief and capability inventory
instruction:
Investigate before drafting. Capture the 5W's and a compact How in this single brief.
During exploration leave How unchosen; refine here rather than creating a design document.
Explain the consequential tradeoff and simplest alternative; ask only material questions.
Use capability names matching existing specs; list new/modified capabilities for the specs artifact.
Unknown feasibility in a spike is an investigation output, not a question the human must answer upfront.
Specs hold observable criteria; link them instead of duplicating requirements.
context:
Keep the human focused on product value and system consequences, not generated lines.
Investigate direct sources before questions; show key findings, distinguish facts from assumptions.
Challenge consequential choices when simpler alternatives, cost or evidence suggest a better outcome.
For spikes, investigate feasibility and conditional outcomes instead of assuming implementation.
Use ordinary repository files, local media and portable HTML/SVG; no proprietary artifact APIs.
Keep overview text roughly one screen; link detail. Do not invent decisions, tests or acceptance.
Prototype only: do not change Phoenix application code or external systems.
rules: Keep 5W + How together, at most 350 words excluding linked detail; omit irrelevant caveats.
Separate user-visible outcomes from backend results and state exclusions.
For existing features distinguish UI/API gates, configured/live flags and verified/unknown deployed revision.
template:
# [Outcome]

## Why
[User/business value; why this matters.]

## What changes
- Who: [affected people and people using the result]
- What: [current → desired outcome; exclusions; spike or implementation]
- Where: [journey and system boundary]
- When: [trigger/decision moment; relevant timing]
- Availability: [existing-feature UI/API gates; configured/live state; deployed revision or unknown]

## How
- Change / Keep: [smallest approach and preserved contracts; unchosen during exploration]
- Verify: [link criteria; setup feasibility and likely regression risks]
- Tradeoff / Recover: [meaningful alternative, cost, blast radius, reversal]

## Capabilities
- New: [capability names, or none]
- Modified: [exact existing capability paths, or none]

## Sources and decisions
[Inspected sources + key finding; actual human choices; material unknowns only.]
